sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops evaluation when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any link is absent, the whole gesture dissolves into nothing.

sketches.mechanism: The `object` keyword creates a singleton — exactly one instance can ever exist
sketches.resonance: Declaring yourself unrepeatable: the language guarantees there will never be another.

sketches.mechanism: A recursive type that contains itself infinitely, made possible by lazy evaluation — the structure exists but can never be fully traversed
sketches.resonance: Longing defined as a thing that always contains more longing; you can hold it, but never reach the end of it.
sketches.draft:
data Longing = Longing Longing

forever :: Longing
forever = Longing forever
